About Me

I am a Food service and Nutrition professional with 14 years of progressive experience in Automatic Vending Machines operations, food safety management, and client-centered nutrition care.

I am ready to contribute comprehensive nutrition support, meticulous attention to food safety protocols, and culturally sensitive client care as a Nutritionist Assistant or Diet Technician.

I am Passionate about improving food access and nutrition outcomes for vulnerable populations through evidence-based practice and compassionate client care.
